suggestions.reason: According to the Seymour Duncan Setups feature, Eric Melvin relied exclusively on the Mesa/Boogie Mark IV Amp Head as his core NOFX tone.
Eric Melvin was listed as a Mesa/Boogie artist on the official Mesa/Boogie website using the Mark V 90-Watt Tube Head, a later-era update to his classic Mark series sound.
Melvin posted on social media (@eric_melvin) that he was 'getting started with the new Fractal Audio Axe-FX III', showing a move toward modelling in his more recent rig.
